pr_body:

issue_context.title: sql: support log(b, x)
issue_context.body:
CockroachDB currently supports base-10 log; we should add the `log(b, x)` overload that permits specifying the log base. (https://www.postgresql.org/docs/12/functions-math.html)

This can be done by adding a new overload to `log` in `pkg/sql/sem/builtins/builtins.go`.
